summary: Coastal Financial Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that Bluevine, Inc., a fintech partner of its Coastal Community Bank unit, agreed to be acquired by Valley National Bancorp, subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions. The filing is a customer/partner-impact update, not a transaction in which Coastal is a party. Coastal reports roughly $447 million of Bluevine-related deposits as of September 25, 2026, out of 22 active CCBX partner relationships as of June 30, 2026. Management does not expect a material adverse effect on liquidity or funding, citing sweep capability and diversified deposits. Watch deposit-retention risk and Q3 disclosure detail.
